project.title: Launch of Unified Analytics-Driven Subscription Product
project.objective: Define, validate, and launch a new subscription-based analytics product that improves revenue predictability and customer insights.
deliverables: Validated product vision and business case
Detailed product requirements and success metrics
Technical feasibility and infrastructure readiness assessment
Go-to-market and pricing strategy for subscription tiers
Pilot launch plan with target customer segments
Post-launch measurement framework and reporting cadence
constraints: Initial pilot must launch within 30 days
Solution must reuse existing data infrastructure where possible
Pricing and contracts must comply with internal revenue policies
No additional full-time headcount can be added for the pilot
Product must support basic self-service onboarding at launch

risks.risk: Unclear product scope leads to scope creep and delays.
risks.mitigation: Lock MVP scope with written acceptance from key stakeholders and track changes via a formal change log.

risks.risk: Data infrastructure cannot support required analytics features.
risks.mitigation: Run early technical assessment and define phased feature rollout aligned with infrastructure capabilities.

risks.risk: Pricing model does not resonate with target customers.
risks.mitigation: Test pricing hypotheses with a small set of customers and adjust tiers before broad launch.

risks.risk: Internal teams are not aligned on positioning and messaging.
risks.mitigation: Create shared messaging guidelines and run enablement sessions for sales and customer success.

risks.risk: Pilot customers churn due to immature onboarding experience.
risks.mitigation: Design a lightweight but clear onboarding checklist and assign owners for each onboarding step.

themes.why_relevant: Keeps the pilot focused on high-impact features and avoids delays from scope creep.
Ensures the analytics product can be delivered using current infrastructure and tools.
Subscription tiers and pricing must align with customer value and revenue goals.
Early feedback from pilot customers reduces risk of misaligned product features.
Multiple teams must coordinate on requirements, delivery, and go-to-market activities.

backlog.task: Define and document the MVP product vision, target segments, and success metrics
definition_of_done: Vision statement and target customer profiles documented in shared doc
MVP feature list prioritised and agreed by stakeholders
3-5 measurable success metrics defined and baselined

backlog.task: Develop detailed business requirements and user stories for MVP features
definition_of_done: Business requirements document completed and reviewed
User stories with acceptance criteria captured in backlog tool
Open questions and assumptions clearly listed and assigned

backlog.task: Assess current data infrastructure and connectivity for analytics product
definition_of_done: Inventory of existing data sources and pipelines completed
Gaps and risks in connectivity and performance documented
Feasibility summary shared with product and business teams

backlog.task: Create financial model and business case for subscription product
definition_of_done: Revenue and cost assumptions documented and validated with finance
3-year subscription revenue scenarios modelled
Business case approved by executive leadership

backlog.task: Design subscription tiers, pricing, and discount guidelines
definition_of_done: Tier definitions and feature mapping completed
Pricing ranges and discount rules documented
Alignment obtained from sales and finance stakeholders

backlog.task: Define operational processes for onboarding and supporting pilot customers
definition_of_done: End-to-end onboarding process mapped with owners per step
Support workflows and escalation paths documented
Customer success team briefed on new processes

backlog.task: Draft go-to-market messaging and value proposition for the pilot
definition_of_done: Core messaging and value proposition written and reviewed
Key objections and responses documented for sales
Marketing and sales sign off on messaging

backlog.task: Prepare pilot customer selection criteria and target list
definition_of_done: Selection criteria defined and documented
Candidate customer list compiled with rationale
Shortlist of pilot customers agreed with sales and leadership

backlog.task: Plan and schedule infrastructure changes needed for the pilot
definition_of_done: Required infrastructure changes listed and prioritised
Implementation timeline aligned with pilot launch date
Risks and rollback plans documented

backlog.task: Define KPIs dashboard and reporting cadence for post-launch tracking
definition_of_done: List of KPIs and data sources agreed with stakeholders
Dashboard layout and ownership defined
Reporting cadence and recipients documented

backlog.task: Align internal teams on roles, responsibilities, and communication plan
definition_of_done: RACI matrix created and shared
Communication channels and meeting cadence agreed
All key teams confirm understanding of responsibilities

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot learnings and propose next-phase roadmap
definition_of_done: Pilot feedback and performance data summarised
Key learnings and improvement areas identified
Roadmap proposal for next 2-3 releases documented

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope, target customers, and success metrics for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message from product manager sharing draft MVP vision and asking for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the MVP feature set and explicitly defer lower-priority items.
Confirm the primary target customer segment for the pilot launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Validate technical feasibility and agree on infrastructure changes for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Telecommunications equipment maintainer posts findings from infrastructure assessment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which infrastructure changes are in-scope for the pilot timeline.
Confirm that current data pipelines can support the defined KPIs.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on pricing, subscription tiers, and discount rules.
threads_plan.trigger: Business consultant shares initial pricing model and tier proposal.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final set of subscription tiers for the pilot.
Approve discount thresholds and required approval levels.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define onboarding process and internal responsibilities for pilot customers.
threads_plan.trigger: Department manager posts draft onboarding process and RACI for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the onboarding checklist and assign owners for each step.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on next-phase roadmap.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager shares early pilot KPIs and customer feedback summary.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to expand, iterate, or pause the product after the pilot.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts progress, blockers, and next steps.
Weekly scope and risk check-in thread to review changes, dependencies, and mitigations.
Pre-pilot readiness review to confirm MVP scope, infrastructure, and onboarding readiness.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture learnings and agree on roadmap adjustments.
